name: year
description: Fall year of the school year the record refers to (2020 denotes school year 2020-21)

name: agency_id
description: NCES local education agency (school district) identification number, or LEAID (7 characters: 2-digit state FIPS followed by a 5-digit agency number)
observations: Zero-padded to 7 characters on load; the source strips leading zeros in the enrollment extracts.

name: state_id
description: State FIPS code as reported by the CCD
observations: Zero-padded to 2 characters. The CCD extends the state FIPS list with codes for jurisdictions that are not states (58 Department of Defense schools overseas, 59 Bureau of Indian Education, 61 and 63 Department of Defense domestic and overseas areas), so this column is not a strict foreign key into the state directory.

name: county_id
description: County FIPS code (5 digits) of the agency's location

name: agency_id_state
description: Local education agency identification number assigned by the state

name: agency_name
description: Local education agency (school district) name

name: county_name
description: County name

name: cbsa_id
description: OMB core-based statistical area code of the vintage in force in the school year

name: cbsa_type
description: Whether the core-based statistical area is metropolitan or micropolitan

name: csa_id
description: OMB combined statistical area code of the vintage in force in the school year

name: cmsa_id
description: Consolidated metropolitan statistical area code (discontinued after 2003)

name: necta_id
description: New England city and town area code

name: congressional_district_id
description: State and congressional district identification number

name: state_leg_district_lower

name: state_leg_district_upper
description: State legislative district, upper chamber

name: supervisory_union_number
description: Supervisory union identification number, where the agency belongs to one

name: street_location

name: city_location
description: City of the location address

name: state_location

name: zip_location

name: zip_mailing
